outputs.issues: No Data Availability Section (DAS) was found. The manuscript only contains a link to 'Supplementary information' but no DAS. According to requirements, a DAS must directly follow the Materials and Methods section. It should either: (a) list each deposited dataset as separate bullet points including measurement type, repository name/acronym, accession number/DOI, and a resolvable link (identifiers.org or full URL), or (b) if no datasets were deposited, include the statement: 'This study includes no data deposited in external repositories'. Please add a properly formatted DAS immediately after Materials and Methods.
